$comment: Alien Labs scopes the task 'Ship the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin'. Astrid is the local user, who joins late and waves; Lucía leads and shares her screen (the plugin-metrics-screenshare.mjs recording) `screenshare.at` seconds after the lead-in. Each `image` is a Higgsfield still, made from the participant's `higgsfield` prompts (a soul_cast character, then a gpt_image_2_5 webcam scene referencing it), that heygen.mjs turns into a HeyGen photo avatar, recorded in <out>/cast.json. Lines with `at` start that many seconds after the lead-in; lines with no `text` are silent gestures. See README.md beside this file.

higgsfield.scene: Seen through the webcam on top of her desktop monitor during a video call: a woman in her mid 20s, Scandinavian, straight blonde hair in a low ponytail, thin silver round glasses, black tailored blazer over a cream top, friendly professional expression, looking straight into the camera at eye level, centered, head, shoulders and forearms resting on the desk visible. Nothing between her and the camera: no laptop, no screen, no keyboard in the foreground. Behind her an office interior with no windows: a light grey wall, a wooden shelf with binders and a small plant, part of a glass-walled meeting room. Even office lighting, photorealistic, natural skin, slight webcam softness.
listening: Unedited webcam footage of a business video call, fixed camera, one continuous take. The woman listens to colleagues: mouth closed, not speaking, attentive, nods, glances down and types notes on a keyboard below the frame, looks back up at the camera, a slight smile. Subtle, realistic, documentary. Ends in the same pose as it starts.

Unedited webcam footage of a business video call, fixed camera, one continuous take. The woman listens to colleagues: mouth closed, not speaking, glances at a second screen to her side, types a note on a keyboard below the frame, looks back at the camera and nods. Subtle, realistic, documentary. Ends in the same pose as it starts.

lines.speaker: astrid
lines.motion: Has just joined a video call: smiles and gives a friendly wave at the camera with one hand, then lowers the hand and settles in.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.motion: Glances up at the camera, smiles and gives a small, brief wave with one hand, then looks back down.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.motion: Looks up at the camera, smiles and gives a small nod hello, mouth closed.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: We're scoping the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin. Customers want cache hit rate per repo, and which builds missed.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I sketched it as a plank: a hit-rate chart across the top, and a table of recent builds underneath.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: The table can be a live query over build records, so it updates the moment Builder pushes a run.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Can we flag the slowest misses? That's the conversation we want to have with customers.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Sure. A red badge on any miss over a minute, linking straight to its trace.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I'll have Builder draft the query, and I can show a first cut in storybook on Thursday.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Great. Ben shares the sketch today, Tomás builds the plank, and I'll check it with Okapi. Thanks, everyone.
